attacks.claim: [cpca 800 ¶1] is next to what b70 cites, opens with «باستثناء», and the record neither cites it nor says why it does not apply: «المحاكم الإدارية هي جهات الولاية العامة في المنازعات الإدارية، باستثناء المنازعات الموكلة إلى جهات قضائية أخرى.»

The losing owner may escape the compensation by accepting renewal and bearing the costs within fifteen days of the judgment becoming final, while the lessee is still in the premises and has not leased or bought another building. | no: «ولا يجوز ممارسة هذا الحق مادام المستأجر مازال موجودا في الاماكن وما دام لم يؤجر أو لم يشتر عمارة أخرى» prohibits exercise in the stated situation. For a judicial-council judgment, the period starts «ابتداء من يوم صدور الحكم», rather than when it becomes final.

The commercial section of the court hears this claim. | partly: The TEXT gives general jurisdiction rules but does not identify 'this claim' or establish that it falls within the commercial section's jurisdiction.

The time limit is 2 years, running from the date of lease action arose on; it is a limitation period, counted by the method excludeFirstDay; it applies when commercial lease is yes and lease chapter action other than refusal is yes. | partly: The TEXT does not state that the two years start when the lease action arose. It excludes actions under articles 196 and 197 without identifying those exceptions as equivalent to 'refusal' actions.

The lessor's answer must restate the content of the article on the dispute procedure, or it is void. | partly: The supplied paragraph does not identify the notification as the lessor's answer or state that article 194 concerns the dispute procedure.

When the lessor offers substitute premises, the lessee either accepts by extrajudicial act within three months or sues on the conditions set for a refusal to renew. | partly: The supplied paragraph does not identify the situation as an offer of substitute premises; it refers to paragraph 2 without supplying its content.

Failing agreement within the following three months, the request goes to the competent court and is decided under the procedure for fixing the lease terms. | partly: The TEXT refers to articles 195 and 196 but does not state that they prescribe the procedure for fixing lease terms.

The provisions also apply, subject to the special compensation provisions, to leases of premises owned by the State, wilayas, communes or public bodies when they meet the scope conditions. | partly: The TEXT refers to articles 185 and 186 but does not identify them as special compensation provisions.

Renewal may also be refused without compensation if total or partial demolition for officially recognised unfitness, or the impossibility of safe occupation, is proven. | partly: The TEXT states the demolition, officially recognised unfitness and unsafe-occupation conditions, but does not state the consequence of permitting refusal of renewal without compensation.

Before a claim in which commercial lease is yes and contract date is before 2005-02-09 and priority right in issue is yes, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: No contract-date cutoff of 2005-02-09 is stated. The TEXT requires notice to benefit from the priority right, but does not expressly make it a prerequisite to filing a claim.

Leases made from the date the amending law was published must be in official form on pain of nullity, for a term the parties set freely. | partly: The TEXT refers to 'this law' («هذا القانون») but does not identify it as an amending law.

Before a claim in which commercial lease is yes and contract date is before 2005-02-09 and lessee contests refusal or claims eviction compensation is yes and notice to quit valid is no, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The TEXT does not state the 2005-02-09 cutoff, equate an invalid notice with absence of notice, or make a renewal request a prerequisite to every action contesting refusal or claiming eviction compensation.

A failure to perform or a cessation of operation may be invoked only if it continued for more than a month after a warning by extrajudicial act stating the ground and restating the paragraph; otherwise the warning is void. | no: «تواصل ارتكابها أو تجديدها لاكثر من شهر» allows continuation or recurrence of the breach; the STATEMENT makes continuation alone necessary.

When commercial lease is yes and dispute only on renewal terms or rent revision is yes, the case leaves the ordinary courts (otherSection). | partly: The TEXT provides proceedings before the president of the competent court under the urgent procedure. It does not state that the case leaves the ordinary courts or assign it to 'otherSection'.

Exception: where substitute premises were offered, the lessee leaves as soon as the provisional compensation fixed by the court president on an expert report is paid. | partly: The TEXT refers to the situation in article 178 paragraph 2 but does not state that this situation involves an offer of substitute premises.

The time limit is 3 months, running from the date of renewal refusal notified on; it is a procedural period; it applies when commercial lease is yes and contract date is before 2005-02-09 and lessee contests refusal or claims eviction compensation is yes. | partly: The TEXT gives no publication date of 2005-02-09, so that contract-date cutoff is unsupported. It sets a summons-service deadline but does not expressly classify the period as procedural.

A lessee entitled to eviction compensation cannot be made to leave before receiving it and stays on the terms of the expired lease; the occupation indemnity is fixed under the rent provisions. | partly: The TEXT says the occupation indemnity is fixed under Chapter V, but does not identify that chapter as the rent provisions.

Before a claim in which commercial lease is yes and resolutory clause for unpaid rent relied on is yes, the debtor must first be put on notice (formal notice). | partly: The TEXT makes an unheeded payment demand a condition for the termination clause to take effect after one month. It does not expressly make notice a prerequisite to filing a claim.

The beneficiary of the take-back must occupy the premises within six months of the lessee leaving and for at least six years, failing which the evicted lessee keeps his right to eviction compensation. | no: «باستثناء السبب المشروع» qualifies the occupancy obligation with an exception for a legitimate reason; the STATEMENT presents the obligation and consequence unconditionally.

The same applies when the lessor refuses renewal on the terms fixed by the court. | partly: The TEXT refers to terms fixed under article 195 but does not state in this extract that the court fixes those terms.

The commercial section hears commercial disputes other than those given to the specialised commercial court. | partly: The TEXT excludes disputes mentioned in article 536 bis but does not state that those disputes are assigned to the specialised commercial court.

Before a claim in which commercial lease is yes and contract date is before 2005-02-09 and the petition asks for eviction and not (the petition asks for rescission), a notice to quit must have been given. | partly: The TEXT gives no publication date of 2005-02-09 and does not distinguish eviction petitions from rescission petitions. It requires notice to end the lease under article 173, rather than expressly stating the claimed prerequisite to filing suit.

The lessee notifies the owner by extrajudicial act of his intent to use the priority right when leaving or within three months after, then has three months after the owner's offer to answer or sue. | partly: The TEXT grants the later three-month period but does not state that it runs from the owner's offer; the paragraph describing the relevant notification is not supplied.

Before a claim in which commercial lease is yes and contract date is before 2005-02-09 and refusal without compensation for breach is yes, the debtor must first be put on notice (formal notice). | partly: The TEXT does not state the 2005-02-09 cutoff or expressly make the warning a prerequisite to filing a claim. It makes the warning a condition for invoking the continuing or renewed breach.

A rent revision request is made by extrajudicial act or registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt and must, on pain of nullity, state the rent asked or offered. | partly: The supplied paragraph states the request's form and required rent amount but does not identify it as a rent revision request.

The notice to quit must be an extrajudicial act stating its reasons and restating the content of the article on the dispute procedure, or it is void. | partly: The TEXT requires restating article 194 but does not state in this extract that article 194 concerns the dispute procedure.
